'''''Rubus canescens''''' is a European and Middle Eastern species of [[brambles]] in the [[Rosaceae|rose family]]. It grows in southern and central Europe and in southwestern Asia from [[Portugal]] to [[Iran]], north as far as [[Germany]], [[Poland]], and [[Ukraine]].<ref name=w>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=rubus+canescens Altervista Flora Italiana, Rovo tomentoso, ''Rubus canescens'' DC.] includes photos and European distribution map</ref><ref>[http://ichn.iec.cat/Bages/arbusts/Imatges%20Grans/cRubus%20canescens.htm Institució Catalana d’Història Natural,  Zarza cana ''(Rubus canescens)'' ] in [[Castillian Spanish]], with photos</ref><ref name=k>[http://www.tela-botanica.org/bdtfx-nn-57986-synthese Tela Botanica,  ''Rubus canescens'' DC.] in French</ref>

The genetics of ''Rubus'' is extremely complex, so that it is difficult to decide on which groups should be recognized as species. There are many rare species with limited ranges such as this. Further study is suggested to clarify the taxonomy.<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=128837 Flora of North America, ''Rubus'' Linnaeus, 1754.  Bramble ]</ref>
